component.name: VFX Photo Lab
component.summary: Non-destructive photo editor for Linux and Windows

description.p: VFX Photo Lab is a free and open-source photo editor built around a canvas, adjustment layers, reusable projects and responsive large-image processing.
Aligns the primary/secondary colour pair and turns the swap/default corner gaps into clean chrome-free action targets.
Gives every toolbar and vector-shape tool a dedicated replaceable 24 × 24 icon resource, including Line and Arrow placeholders.
Adds pixel-boundary whole-layer transforms and asynchronously prepared transform previews for immediate repeated gestures.
Adds a shared snapping toggle, half-pixel guide placement and pixel-boundary vector geometry.
Completes adjustment expansion with Curves and Hue/Saturation on-image sampling, Gradient Map editing improvements, bounded multicore exact histograms and multi-document interaction hardening.
Adds Surface Blur, angle-aware Motion Blur and bounded Spin/Zoom Radial Blur with anisotropic tiled dependencies and deterministic multicore references.
Fixes the Fedora build by removing a duplicate internal smooth-step helper while preserving all 0.13.0e effects and schemas.
Adds document-relative Vignette, creative RGB Split and manual radial chromatic-aberration correction adjustment layers.
Adds Selective Colour and hardens Colour Balance, Channel Mixer and Black & White with shared advanced-colour infrastructure and presets.
Adds Invert and managed Photo Filter adjustment layers while preserving and hardening Vibrance, Threshold and Posterise.
Keeps Unsharp Mask and High Pass previews at full detail during slider interaction and reuses the completed level-0 frame on release.
Keeps the last complete blur/sharpen interaction mip visible until its replacement or final level-0 render commits, eliminating slider flicker.
Parallelises CPU blur and sharpen references and adds responsive mip-scaled slider previews with unchanged full-quality final rendering.
Fixes the Qt 6 Fedora build by including the complete QColorSpace type in the spatial-filter implementation.
Adds non-destructive Gaussian Blur, Box Blur, Unsharp Mask and High Pass adjustment layers on the radius-aware tiled spatial-filter foundation.
Adds reusable tile-halo, edge, Alpha, cancellation, cache and CPU/WGSL spatial-filter contracts.
Fixes retained tool-options widget actions at shutdown, hardens Smudge image writes and adds ASan/UBSan diagnostic builds.
Removes event-scaled Smudge preview copies, uses continuous dab spacing and limits final history work to path-touched tiles.
Improves long Smudge-stroke performance, imports isolated GPU validation results without rerunning the full suite in the GUI, and fixes canvas/GPU shutdown ordering.
Completes the colour-management milestone with project/residency hardening, immutable ICC/OCIO resource audits, no silent substitution and final deterministic conformance coverage.
Adds explicit ICC/OCIO working-to-output export, 8/16-bit format controls, Alpha-safe output handling and deterministic RGB blue-noise dithering.
Adds parity-gated RGBA8/RGBA16 WGSL evaluation of CPU-reference display, OCIO View and soft-proof lattices, plus managed working-to-adjustment-domain compositor transforms with exact CPU fallback.
Adds presentation-only monitor ICC and OCIO Display/View colour management, soft-proof controls, monitor discovery and schema-4 legacy appearance protection.
Polishes the initial sizing of colour-management and OCIO/ACES dialogs while retaining the OpenColorIO static-package handoff and GCC 16 dependency compatibility fixes.
Adds explicit working-space selection, Assign Profile and transactional Convert to Profile workflows with RGBA8/RGBA16, semantic-colour, Undo/Redo, cancellation and persistence coverage.
Adds ICC-aware image ingress, consistent untagged-image policy, profile diagnostics and schema-2 colour-state persistence without converting pixels.
Fixes asynchronous paint commits being rejected after mouse release because their render identity omitted the document colour-state revision.
Removes Qt deprecation and GCC narrowing warnings from the 0.11.0a colour-state foundation without changing behaviour.
Adds explicit document colour-state architecture, legacy-project appearance protection, version-15 persistence, version-16 residency and colour-aware cache identities.
Fixes the GCC build ambiguity in the LUT Inspector domain-source formatter without changing LUT behaviour or persisted schemas.
Adds complete LUT Inspector diagnostics, interpolation control, persistence/residency hardening and safer user preset storage.
Adds direct RGBA16Float LUT upload, native trilinear/tetrahedral and transfer/operator evaluation, expanded startup parity and selective CPU fallback.
Adds persisted Tony McMapface and AgX Base sRGB operator pipelines with reference preprocessing, tetrahedral CPU evaluation, import detection and safe migration.
Adds explicit encoded, linear sRGB/Rec.709 and raw-component LUT processing contracts with transfer-aware CPU evaluation, persistence and selective GPU fallback.
Adds the authoritative scalar LUT evaluator with deterministic trilinear/tetrahedral interpolation, explicit table staging and unclamped intermediate output.
Adds strict Cube parser and LUT data-model conformance with duplicate/conflict validation, finite-value preservation, range-source persistence and actionable line-numbered diagnostics.
Adds independent deterministic LUT conformance fixtures and known-defect baselines, plus New from Clipboard with image metadata preservation.
Completes the vector workflow milestone with bounded project/vector decoding and end-to-end persistence, alpha, residency, merge and Fill/Gradient regression hardening.
Preserves layer multi-selection on context click and restores independent editability for every path object in merged vector layers.
Adds atomic raster-with-raster and vector-with-vector layer merging, including editable semantic-shape-to-path conversion for vector results.
Makes Gradient placement responsive with a coalesced asynchronous screen-resolution preview while retaining the unchanged full-resolution commit path.
Adds live selection-aware Linear, Radial, Angle, Reflected and Diamond raster gradients for layers, masks and editable channels with atomic Undo and parity-gated tiled GPU application.
Fixes native Fill shader validation by replacing unsupported multi-component swizzle assignment and adding build/runtime WGSL guards.
Adds a selection-aware raster Fill Tool for layers, masks and editable channels with tolerance, contiguous/global matching, transparency controls and parity-gated tiled GPU application.
Adds reusable vector appearance presets with full fill, stroke, dash and arrowhead styling plus save, apply, rename and delete management.
Restricts arrowhead shaft-cap clipping to the local endpoint footprint so winding Pen paths retain all unrelated stroke segments.
Centres endpoint arrowheads so shaft caps cannot blunt pointed markers and hides inapplicable arrow controls for closed vector shapes.
Adds independent stroke arrowheads, SVG markers, Expand Stroke integration and a semantic filled Arrow Shape.
Preserves nonzero winding for expanded dashed strokes so overlapping dash islands expand reliably without connector spokes.
Restores dashed Expand Stroke by filtering only zero-area seam debris while retaining independent editable dash contours and clean compound stroke rings.
Hardens Expand Stroke with independent dashed contours and seam-free editable compound stroke rings.
Adds editable Expand Stroke geometry for alignment, caps, joins, miter limits and dashed outlines while preserving layer compositing.
Adds fixed-screen vector component hover feedback, distinct selection styling and overlap-aware hit targeting.
Adds fill/stroke swap and reset actions, validated appearance copy/paste, and restores middle-mouse panning in vector path tools.
Adds keyboard node selection, document-space nudging, safe deletion and Escape-first deselection for Direct Selection and Corner Tool.
Adds endpoint-aware Pen continuation, open-path joining, close/continue/join feedback and segment-safe cancellation.
Adds explicit appearance-preserving conversion from semantic vector shapes to editable Bézier paths.
Adds Shape-style Fill, Stroke, colour, width and detailed solid/dashed stroke controls to the Pen Tool top options bar.
Adds semantic dashed vector strokes, primary-stroke/secondary-fill creation defaults and a bundled Corner Tool placeholder icon.
Adds a true Make Sharp Direct Selection operation that collapses both Bézier handles into the anchor while retaining Make Corner as the separate handle-decoupling command.
